newsitem.title: USA: Video Lottery unit gets $12 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Video Lottery unit gets $12 mln contract.

text.p: Video Lottery Technologies Inc said Wednesday its Automated Wagering International Inc unit has an eight-year, $12 million contract to supply on-line services to a Latin American lottery.
The company said Automated Wagering wll provide its Masterlink gaming technology in tandem with a Latin American information technology company's contract to provide an on-line lottery system.
The company did not identify the specific country in Latin America that it will serve, nor did it identify the Latin American company with which it will work.
The company said the contract can be renewed for an additional five-year term.
